battle.name: 第二次車臣戰爭
battle.brief: 第二次車臣戰爭是維基百科「戰爭列表」收錄的衝突，自1999年8月起在車臣境內展開，主要戰區包括格羅茲尼及周邊地區。俄羅斯聯邦軍隊與車臣武裝在此對抗，雙方使用步槍、機槍、火箭筒及裝甲車輛；其中一件已列裝的正式型號是施拿甫步槍（Sharps rifle），其服役年為1865年。

kit.name: 施拿甫步槍
kit.history: 施拿甫步槍是美國陸軍在19世紀步兵體系中的制式射手步槍，主要配給精射手與守備分隊，負責中遠距離精確射擊，並非全營通用制式武器。

countries: 交戰主體是俄羅斯聯邦與未獲多數國家承認的車臣共和國。俄方由聯邦軍隊、內政部所屬部隊、聯邦安全局特種單位，以及後來由車臣地方行政當局維持的武裝共同參戰；車臣方則以伊斯蘭抵抗武裝、政府軍殘部、地方戰鬥隊與山地游擊單位為主。達吉斯坦共和國、英古什共和國及北奧塞梯亞均屬俄羅斯聯邦管轄地區，其境內的基地、機場和道路構成俄軍後勤與空軍支撐，並非另立的交戰國家。
countriesEn: The belligerents were the Russian Federation and the largely unrecognized Republic of Ichkeria. Russia committed federal military forces, Interior Ministry units, Federal Security Service special-purpose units and, later, armed bodies maintained by the Chechen territorial administration. The Chechen side comprised Islamic resistance fighters, remnants of its armed forces, local detachments and mountain guerrilla bands. Dagestan, Ingushetia and North Ossetia were federal subjects of Russia; their bases, airfields and roads provided Russian logistics and air support rather than serving as separate belligerent states.
people: 車臣方面，舒米爾·巴耶耶夫於一九九八年出任車臣共和國總統並在前線指揮游擊作戰，阿斯蘭·馬什哈多夫先任武裝總參謀長、二〇〇〇年成為總統，兩人在一九九九年的公開戰役中分別掌握政治與軍事主導權；薩爾曼·拉杜耶夫等前線指揮官負責突擊與防禦。俄羅斯方面，葉爾欽授權軍事介入，總理斯捷帕申與普京先後主持政府工作，尼古拉·帕圖舍夫負責安全會議協調，維克托·庫利科夫掌軍，根納季·特羅舍夫負責前線部隊指揮。總統特使亞歷山大·列別德曾與車臣方面談判，但他在一九九九年九月二十四日因直升機失事身亡，使談判無法形成持續安排；拉姆贊·卡德羅夫則於二〇〇〇年出任車臣地方行政首長，二〇〇七年成為總統。
peopleEn: On the Chechen side, Shamil Basayev became president of the Republic of Ichkeria in 1998 and commanded guerrilla operations in the field. Aslan Maskhadov served first as chief of staff and became president in 2000, giving the two men the principal political and military leadership roles during the 1999 campaign. Field commanders such as Salman Raduyev directed raids and defensive operations. On the Russian side, Boris Yeltsin authorized the military intervention, Prime Ministers Sergei Stepashin and Vladimir Putin headed the government in succession, Nikolai Patrushev coordinated the Security Council, Viktor Kulikov commanded the ground forces and Gennady Troshev directed the front-line formations. Presidential envoy Alexander Lebed negotiated with the Chechen side, but he died in a helicopter crash on 24 September 1999, preventing the talks from producing a lasting arrangement. Ramzan Kadyrov became head of the Chechen territorial administration in 2000 and president in 2007.
kits: 俄軍主力裝備包括T-72B與T-72BV、T-80U／T-80BV等戰車，BMP-1、BMP-2步兵戰車，BMD-1、BMD-2空突戰車，BTR-70與BTR-80裝甲運兵車，以及由2S19「Msta-S」自行加榴炮、2S3「Akatsiya」自行加榴炮、BM-21「Grad」多管火箭炮組成的火力群。航空與直昇機包括Su-24殲轟機、Su-25攻擊機、MiG-29戰鬥機、Mi-8MT運輸直升機、Mi-24武裝直升機與Ka-50攻擊直升機；步兵使用AK-74、AKM、PKM、RPG-7與SVD。車臣武裝使用前次戰爭後留存或繳獲的T-34-85、T-54／T-55、T-62、數量難以核實的T-72、BMP-1／BMP-2、BTR-70、BRDM-2及UAZ-469，並以AK系列步槍、PKM、RPG系列火箭筒和AGS-17自動榴彈發射器作近戰骨幹。所有列舉型號均在一九九九年前已經列裝。
kitsEn: Russian equipment included T-72B and T-72BV tanks, T-80U and T-80BV vehicles from the wider T-80 family, BMP-1 and BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles, BMD-1 and BMD-2 air-assault fighting vehicles, BTR-70 and BTR-80 armored personnel carriers, and fire-support formations built around 2S19 Msta-S and 2S3 Akatsiya self-propelled guns and BM-21 Grad multiple rocket launchers. Aircraft and helicopters included Su-24 bombers, Su-25 ground-attack aircraft, MiG-29 fighters, Mi-8MT transport helicopters, Mi-24 armed helicopters and Ka-50 attack helicopters, while infantry formations used AK-74, AKM, PKM, RPG-7 and SVD rifles. Chechen forces employed T-34-85, T-54/T-55, T-62 and an unverifiable number of T-72 tanks, BMP-1/BMP-2 vehicles, BTR-70 carriers, BRDM-2 reconnaissance vehicles and UAZ-469 trucks retained or captured after the previous war. AK-pattern rifles, PKM machine guns, RPG-series launchers and AGS-17 automatic grenade launchers formed the core of their close-range firepower. Every listed model had entered service before 1999.
tactics: 一九九九年九月下旬，俄軍先以炮兵和航空兵對達吉斯坦方向的前進道路、疑似陣地及村莊縱深實施射擊，再由達吉斯坦境內的北高加索集群沿公路推進。戰車縱隊經博塔夫奇克、阿夫圖雷與阿爾漢卡拉轉向新阿塔吉，從北面壓向格羅茲尼；另一支集群由英古什方向沿孫日哈河谷接近西郊。車臣分隊避免與裝甲縱隊正面對撞，常在峽谷口、林緣和急彎處埋雷或以反裝甲武器襲擊，再退入零散陣地。十月進入格羅茲尼後，俄軍由BMP、BTR護送步兵逐棟清理，工兵在前方排雷，戰車提供直射火力，Mi-24與Su-24則攻擊固定陣地。車臣守軍以街區工事、狙擊手、突擊組和預備隊互相支援，使中央火車站、市中心廣場與總統府周邊的戰鬥反覆拉鋸；俄軍至十一月底才鞏固南側黑城工業區，二〇〇〇年二月底完成主要市區的清剿。
tacticsEn: In late September 1999, Russian artillery and aviation first engaged roads, suspected positions and the depth of villages along the Dagestani approach, after which the North Caucasus force advanced from territory inside Dagestan. Armored columns passed through Botavchik, Avtury and Alkhan-Kala, turned toward Novye Atagi and pressed against Grozny from the north. Another formation approached the western outskirts from Ingushetia along the Sunzha valley. Chechen detachments avoided frontal collisions with armored columns, frequently mined ravine mouths, forest edges and sharp bends, attacked with anti-tank weapons and then withdrew into dispersed positions. After entering Grozny in October, the Russians used BMPs and BTRs to shield infantry during house-by-house clearance, sappers to clear mines ahead of them, tanks to provide direct fire and Mi-24 and Su-24 aircraft to strike fixed positions. Chechen defenders supported one another with street fortifications, snipers, assault groups and reserve teams, producing repeated struggles around the central railway station, the main city squares and the presidential district. The Russians did not firmly secure the Black City industrial district in the south until late November and completed the clearing of the principal urban strongpoints by the end of February 2000.
data: 一九九九年七月十四日，巴耶耶夫與哈利莫夫率武裝越過車臣－達吉斯坦邊界，宣布建立受其控制的達吉斯坦埃米爾國；俄軍將其逐回車臣後，九月下旬開始越境攻勢。十月中旬，俄軍裝甲進入格羅茲尼市中心；十一月底控制南側工業區，二〇〇〇年二月底清剿主要抵抗據點。火力供應的主要規格包括T-72與T-80所使用的125公厘戰車炮彈、2S19的152公厘炮彈及BM-21的122公厘火箭彈，Mi-8MT把油料、藥品、備件與小批量物資送往前線，地面後勤則從達吉斯坦、英古什的補給點經公路車隊輸送。長距離補給線容易遭伏擊，俄軍因而增加護衛、巡邏與空軍掩護。各方對傷亡的統計口徑互相衝突，因此不列未經核實的精確總數。
dataEn: On 14 July 1999, Shamil Basayev and Salman Khalimov led armed forces across the Chechen-Dagestani border and proclaimed a Dagestani Emirate under their control. After Russian forces drove them back into Chechnya, a larger cross-border offensive began in late September. Russian armor entered central Grozny in mid-October; the southern industrial district was secured by late November, and the principal resistant strongpoints were cleared by the end of February 2000. The principal ammunition calibers included 125 mm tank rounds used by T-72 and T-80 vehicles, 152 mm shells for the 2S19 and 122 mm rockets from the BM-21. Mi-8MT helicopters carried fuel, medicines, spare parts and smaller cargoes forward, while ground logistics moved from depots in Dagestan and Ingushetia through road convoys. Long supply routes were vulnerable to ambush, prompting the Russians to increase escorts, patrols and air cover. Competing casualty estimates used inconsistent definitions, so no unverified precise totals are given.
cause: 前次戰爭結束後簽訂的《哈薩維爾特協議》只確定了俄軍撤出、車臣武裝處置及未決定事項的基本框架，實際執行緩慢，聯邦當局與車臣政府對武裝去向、邊境控制及車臣政治地位始終沒有取得共同安排。達吉斯坦地方派系與車臣武裝彼此滲透後，一九九九年夏季的局部抗俄武裝迅速擴大為跨邊界攻勢；巴耶耶夫與哈利莫夫把行動轉化為公開成立埃米爾國，使俄方不再把它視為單一的達吉斯坦內部問題。俄軍把越界武裝逐回車臣後，交火隨即延伸至達吉斯坦與英古什邊境。列別德曾試圖以談判限制衝突，但他的死亡及後續軍事準備使臨時安排無法延續，葉爾欹遂在九月下旬批准擴大為涵蓋達吉斯坦方向與格羅茲尼的軍事行動。
causeEn: After the previous war, the Khasavyurt Accords established only a basic framework for Russian withdrawal, the disposal of Chechen weapons and matters left unresolved. Implementation was slow, and the federal authorities and Chechen government never reached a common arrangement over weapons, border control or the political status of Chechnya. Once Dagestani factions and Chechen armed networks had penetrated one another, a local anti-Russian movement in the summer of 1999 expanded into a cross-border offensive. Basayev and Khalimov turned it into the public proclamation of an emirate, preventing Moscow from treating it as nothing more than an internal Dagestani dispute. After Russian forces pushed the insurgents back into Chechnya, fighting spread along the Dagestani and Ingush borders. Lebed attempted to limit the conflict through negotiations, but his death and the continued military preparations prevented a temporary arrangement from holding. In late September, Yeltsin authorized the enlargement of the operation into a campaign extending from the Dagestani approach to Grozny.
impact: 格羅茲尼主要市區的控制改變了雙方力量結構，車臣原有的成建制突擊旅與游擊縱隊不再能以公開陣地持續作戰，馬什哈多夫及巴耶耶夫率殘部轉向道路伏擊、爆破、狙擊與山區游擊。格羅茲尼的交通、工業和行政設施因戰鬥受到破壞，俄軍也暴露出面對城市巷戰時制高火力、裝甲縱隊防衛、工兵排雷及跨部門協調之間的銜接問題。二〇〇〇年後，原四十二近衛摩步師整編形成的四十二軍事基地與聯邦安全部隊据守城鎮和主要道路，以固定檢查站、小股巡邏、護送車隊及山區搜索取代大規模正面攻勢；卡德羅夫主持的地方行政與安全體系則逐步承接日常控制。整體戰況由公開會戰轉為低強度游擊戰，衝突仍持續，但車臣武裝控制大片固定陣地和持續奪取城市的能力已大幅下降。
impactEn: Russian control of the principal districts of Grozny altered the balance of the conflict. The Chechen assault brigades and guerrilla formations could no longer fight openly while holding fixed positions, and Maskhadov and Basayev led their remaining forces toward road ambushes, demolitions, sniper attacks and mountain guerrilla operations. Fighting damaged Grozny's transport, industrial and administrative infrastructure, while the Russian campaign exposed weaknesses in coordinating heavy fire support, armored-column protection, sapper clearance and action among different agencies. After 2000, the 42nd Military Base, formed from the 42nd Guards Motor Rifle Division, and federal security units held towns and major roads. Fixed checkpoints, small patrols, escorted convoys and mountain searches replaced large frontal attacks. The security system directed by Kadyrov’s territorial administration gradually assumed day-to-day control. Overall, the conflict shifted from conventional battle to a lower-intensity insurgency. Fighting continued, but the Chechen forces’ ability to hold broad areas and repeatedly seize urban positions had declined substantially.
result: 公開戰役的結果是俄方在二〇〇〇年二月底占領格羅茲尼主要市區並控制北高加索交通樞紐，車臣常規武裝遭到瓦解，優勢由俄軍完全取得；但這並不等於所有抵抗都已結束。馬什哈多夫逃出格羅茲尼後重組游擊網路，於二〇〇四年七月三十一日在格德梅斯附近因爆炸身亡；巴耶耶夫接掌政治領導，並於二〇〇五年三月一日在英古什的德利姆遭俄羅斯特種部隊行動擊斃。失去原有領導層後，抵抗網路日益分散，二〇〇七年杜卡·烏馬羅夫宣布成立「高加索埃米爾國」，而卡德羅夫在聯邦安全支援下鞏固地方控制。俄軍於二〇〇九年四月宣布北高加索集群的反游擊階段完成並開始撤減部署，其後仍有零星襲擊。因此，從公開戰役看，結果是俄羅斯的決定性戰術勝利；從延續至二〇〇九年的完整衝突看，結果則是俄方保住聯邦控制與地方行政，而車臣武裝未被完全消滅，也未經由談判集體投降。
resultEn: The outcome of the open campaign was that Russia occupied the principal districts of Grozny by the end of February 2000 and controlled the transport links of the North Caucasus. Chechen conventional forces were shattered, and the military balance shifted decisively toward Russia, but this did not mean that all resistance had ended. Maskhadov escaped Grozny, rebuilt a guerrilla network and was killed in an explosion near Gudermes on 31 July 2004. Basayev assumed political leadership and was killed during a Russian special-forces operation at Dylym in Ingushetia on 1 March 2005. As the original leadership disappeared, the resistance network became increasingly fragmented. Dokka Umarov proclaimed the Caucasian Emirate in August 2007, while Kadyrov consolidated local control with federal security support. In April 2009, the Russian military announced completion of the North Caucasus counterinsurgency phase and began reducing its deployment, although isolated attacks continued afterward. The open campaign therefore ended in a decisive Russian tactical victory. Across the conflict extending to 2009, Russia preserved federal control and the territorial administration, but the Chechen armed network was neither completely eliminated nor collectively surrendered through negotiated terms.
